changelog: - **Relations marks only a Parameter the run uses, and a share link opens with every name in view.** A flow row in Relations showed `◇` and a name for any amount that began with `@`: `@{rate}` read as `◇ {rate}`, and `@rate*2`, or an `@` naming a Pool or no node, read as a Parameter though the run moves nothing for it. The row now shows `◇` and the Parameter's name only for an amount the run reads as a Parameter, and any other amount as you wrote it. A share link opened framed on the node shapes only, so a name outside a node at the edge of the diagram could be cut off until Reset view; it now opens as Fit the whole diagram frames it, names included.
